simple.meaning: בָּלַהּ (bâlahh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to palpitate ; hence, (causatively) to terrify.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezra, beginning at Ezra 4:4. The surrounding contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּלַהּ (H1089) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּלַהּ (bâlahh) / H1089 is traced through Ezra 4:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.
